notablePrerequisites:
"Illusion" chosen with Molten Echoes.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce {4}{U}{U}.
description:
Cast Palinchron for {5}{U}{U}.
Palinchron enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Molten Echoes.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
Activate the seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a copy of Palinchron.
The Palinchron copy enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
Activate the seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Activate the non-token Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
